tasks.name: Detection
tasks.desc: Is an earthquake present in a 30-second window? The CNN+Transformer learns waveform morphology a classic threshold detector can't. 5-seed mean AUC 0.977±0.003 on held-out data.

tasks.name: Magnitude
tasks.desc: Network magnitude from multi-station 3-component traces. 5-seed ensemble R² 0.846; the multi-station GNN fusion earns it - a nearest-single-station ablation collapses to R² −0.17.

tasks.name: Early warning · shaking level
tasks.desc: From the first 8 seconds of P-wave, predict the peak ground velocity that arrives later. Ties the physics baseline on the continuous value.

tasks.name: Early warning · alert
tasks.desc: Will shaking exceed a notable threshold? With the alert trigger tuned on validation for recall, the deep model catches 76% of strong-shaking events (up from 65%) at 82% precision. The baseline reaches similar recall only by false-alarming twice as often, so on balanced alert quality (MCC) the deep model wins 0.76 vs 0.66.

disclaimer: Research prototype on real California network data, not an operational warning system. The project's original geomagnetic earthquake-precursor forecast was retired after honest validation showed no out-of-sample signal; it pivoted to seismic-waveform deep learning, where the same architecture works. Short-term earthquake prediction (whether one will occur) remains unsolved - this does detection, characterization, and seconds-ahead shaking estimation.
